name: Hot Oven
disable: 1 Interact action and a DC 18 Athletics check check to close the oven door after it's been opened.
reset: The oven door can be opened and closed freely, as described above, for the course of the entire combat. If left to its own devices, the oven burns through its fuel and goes out roughly 1 hour after it's lit.

items.name: Hot to the Touch
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to open the closed oven door without the protection of an oven mitt

---
Effect The triggering creature takes 1d10+3 fire damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: In You Go!
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves or is forcibly moved into the open oven

---
Effect The triggering creature takes 3d10 fire damage (DC 25 basic Fortitude save save) and 2d6 persistent,fire damage. This damage repeats at the beginning of the creature's turn for as long as it remains inside the oven.

text: This fiery hot oven needs to be extra-large to keep up with the demands of the bakery—large enough for a Medium creature to crawl inside. Or be pushed.
